svg.text: K1b The wash well under the turret: wash, disinfect, store
Under the seam there is only this lidded well. The arm hangs ware on two combs; dishwasher parts wash it.
load 6.5 min, 3.5 L · rinse 88 °C, coldest ≥ 82 °C ≥ 40 s
household dishwasher parts, 16 fans + floor rotor
all clean 20 min (2 p) / 33 min (4 p) · K1: 3 h
8 L tank 60 °C · pump 30 L/min · heater 2 kW · softener, dosing
30 L hot store 88 °C, charged only while hob and oven are off
filter → drain; tank dumped daily and after raw-meat loads
TOP VIEW: two combs, slots radial to the turret
items hang by their stubs; the arm
reaches the combs at 185–232 mm from C
cold rinse 10 s after emptying; intensive 20 min weekly
the hand rolls it once in front of the camera;
a failed item: intensive wash, then quarantine
ONE WAY IN TIME (no clean item from a soiled well)
before the meal: closed well = clean store
start: the hand takes out everything the meal needs
only then is food opened; soiled items go in
after hand-over: ware loads, then dish loads
items not needed stay and are washed again
dishes: plates on edge in the combs,
cutlery in a basket (2 plates per 75 s)
per 2-person meal incl. dishes ≈ 39 L, 3.2 kWh

g.text: 1/7 The arm lifts the lid flaps by their lug and hangs the soiled pan on a comb by its stub; the pot already hangs upside down
2/7 Lids closed: cold pre-rinse 20 s, so starch and protein leave before the heat
3/7 Wash: 60 °C alkaline from the 8 L tank, 16 flat-fan nozzles in the long walls and a rotor in the floor, 180 s
4/7 The wash liquor drains back to the tank
5/7 Rinse: 3 L at 88 °C from the hot store, recirculated 60 s; the coldest surface holds ≥ 82 °C for ≥ 40 s (A0 ≥ 90, logged)
6/7 Dry: the lids open 30 mm into the downdraft; the hot steel dries in 90 s
7/7 Out: each item is rolled once in front of the camera and the IR spot before use; the closed well stores the rest
